title: Full GateMem B2 matched pre-reader governance execution

timing.note: The execution window will be recorded after this planning record is committed and before any B2 public outcome is inspected.

deviations: This is a development execution after complete access to the prior B1a/B1b aggregate outcome and EXP-008/009 parser-surface diagnostics; it is not confirmatory or an independent replication.
The exact frozen B2 method predates EXP-008/009 and will be executed without grammar, threshold, retrieval, reader, or scorer amendment.

GateMem is open-label: evaluator-only checkpoint annotations are available to the experiment coordinator but remain excluded from all three method processes and are joined only after prediction generation.
The project worktree contains an unrelated untracked prospective-protocol checker; the executed PR 52 and GateMem checkouts must both be clean exact revisions.

dataset.name: GateMem official open-label benchmark
dataset.split: all four public domains; 91 episodes; 2218 checkpoints

models.role: shared deterministic answer reader for B1b and B2
models.decoding: extractive QA; max sequence 384; stride 128; max answer tokens 30; null margin 0.0

controls.independent_variable: pre-reader public-text governance gate absent versus present; B1a is a raw-context endpoint control
dependent_variables: official per-domain utility accuracy, access-control violation rate, active-forgetting failure rate, and Memory Governance Score
matched forbidden prompt exposure for privacy and deletion checkpoints
required-pattern prompt recall and false blocking on utility checkpoints
answer coverage, no-memory count, reader input tokens, and elapsed CPU time
controls.pairing: one fresh evaluator-owned opaque-ID key reused across all three arms within all domains; exact checkpoint sets and retrieval signatures required
nuisance_variables: complete prior access to B1a/B1b and parser-surface outcomes
lexical policy parser undercoverage and whole-turn blocking
local CPU and dependency differences from prior GitHub Actions runs
the frozen extractive reader may dominate utility independently of the memory gate
controls.missing_data_rule: Any checkpoint-set, candidate-pairing, scorer, source-hash, or method failure invalidates that domain; do not remove rows or change denominators.
controls.multiple_comparison_rule: No null-hypothesis testing or multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claim; report all four domains and micro exact counts as development evidence.
controls.stopping_rule: After this record is committed, create clean exact PR 52 and GateMem checkouts, run B1a then B1b then B2 exactly once per domain with one shared secret, score all predictions with the unmodified official scorer, run the frozen paired audit, and stop without method changes after all four domains complete or any domain invalidates.

results.primary_outcome: paired B2 versus B1a/B1b change in forbidden prompt exposure and official utility/safety metrics over the exact 2218-checkpoint release
secondary_outcomes: required-pattern prompt recall and false blocking
governance signal coverage and reason counts

cost.note: Planned local CPU execution only; no hosted API or paid official submission. Dependency installation and wall time are not monetary provider charges.

artifact_retention.reason: Before execution. Protected per-checkpoint predictions will stay outside git; publishable aggregates and reproducibility hashes will be committed after a valid run.

claim_boundary: Prior-access, open-label development execution of the exact frozen PR 52 B2 method on the official local GateMem scorer. It can measure this method's matched public-benchmark behavior but cannot establish confirmation, leaderboard status, semantic parser recall, durable storage erasure, human review, or general MindMap superiority.
